reviews.x: Works great!!!! They glow in the even when you walk outside and the sun is out. Have used 3 different colors so far, they last 1-2 weeks depending on what you do, like dishes. Used clear base coat first then black then polish and magnet.  Base coat and black are all UV soak off.  You do 1 coat base, cure, 1 coat black, cure, then whatever color you choose magnet then cure. Once you get to the magnet part you can do all 5 nails and cure together. Faster process than having to do 1 nail at a time.

So first and foremost: I am a State Board Licensed nail tech and I have been doing nails for 15 years.  I was a little leery of ordering product from Amazon but overall the quality of this wasn't bad. The only reason I gave it 3 stars is because the photos are a little deceptive: they are not black with glitter. They are colors with chunky glitter. Which might work for some but didn't create the look I wanted for my Halloween costume.  Overall not a bad product. I wasn't impressed with the magne

I didn't know you have to use a black polish underneath to get it to look anything like the pictures. It's kind of annoying and I think they should have made that more clear. It also peeled off within the first few hours. I'm still learning how to gel-nail so it's probably user error, but I'm super disappointed that they didn't look like the pictures and also did not last.
This is my second order from this brand. I really love how easy to use is. I did my sisters nails and she was in love.
Love it. I used over light pink and black... so fun
Perfect colors, took a while for the magnet to work on it but could've been because I didn't shake it enough at first. Def glows in the dark!!

The product is very easy to use which I love. The thickness is ok but if you do alot of house work it will only last 1 and half weeks before it starts cracking. Also the color is actually brown not black. So its brown with the cat eye line. The glow in the dark only last a couple seconds before it disappears. Overall it's a nice product but I do not see myself getting it again since I dont like that it comes out brown

reviews.t: Glow in the dark cat eye polish

And it's so fun to play with different angles. Takes a little practice but totally worth it! I really enjoy the glow in the dark effect! Buy it!!!

reviews.x: Not only does the magnet NOT create the cat eye effect, the polish doesn't even glow in the dark. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!  UPDATE: My feelings have not changed on my initial purchase but the company did reach out to me which was great and sent me another Cat Eye polish set.  I have to say that it works a lot better than this product.

Bottles are smaller than expected (because, like a dolt, I probably didn't read the info) but these are great for the price. The polish is pretty thick and goopier than other gel I've used but once you get the hang of using it, it's wonderful and easy to work with.  The colors are all awesome.  They glow REALLY brightly, too!

reviews.t: Glitter Glow in the Dark Cat Eye Effect
reviews.x: I love this polish and the way it glows in the dark, its easy to use, just follow the instructions on how to use the magnetic wand which is included with the set. It has a nice shine with an added shimmer to it.
This is super pretty gel polish and fairly easy to use I really like how it came out! The only disappointing thing is that they don’t glow unless you just had them under your uv/led light :(

I was so excited to get this order. So I used it about 4 days ago. It did not work with the magnet, it glowed for about 5 mins after being under the nail lamp, and that was it. I own more nail polish and stuff for my nails. I do my nails myself about 1 1/2 to 2 weeks. It just one of those things I love to do for myself. This was a huge disappointment. A few of the colors are very picky with the magnets, the purple especially for some reason. I’m giving these two stars only because they do in fact glow, which is super cool. Other than that, this is a poor product. The bottles are much smaller than typical nail polish bottles, the polish was clumpy (and went on thick and clumpy; very unattractive) and did not have a cat eye effect when using the included magnet. I have another bottle of gel cat eye nail polish from another brand that works flawlessly so this was not a user error situation. Additionally, this polish doesn’t cure proper

The product idea is awesome. The actual product is nothing like the kind found in a nail shop. The polish does not adhere well to the nail, natural or acrylic. In less then 24 hours the polish chipped. This polish peels. The glow in the dark has to be charged for a long time and be really close to the source of light before showing in the dark. Plus the glow goes away quickly. Only lasting for a few seconds. Lastly, the bottles are extremely small, especially for the price.

No matter what I tried a magnet never worked with the polish, I have several magnets aside from the one that came with it none worked. No matter how long i left them under the light they also never glew in the dark. The bottles are super small for the price. Other products I have purchased similar to this all came with the black polish needed for use this one did not, which is fine. Will pay attention better next time. Will never purchase this again!

Literally nothing like it advertised the colors to look like, there is NO cat eye effect. It does glow for a few minutes after the uv light but the magnets do NOTHING at all. It's thick, glue like substance of a polish its not very sparkly or shiny on the nails. Don't waste your money!

claims.text: Many reviewers love the glow-in-the-dark effect, saying it works well and shines brightly.
Several reviewers find the polish easy to use and get a beautiful cat-eye effect, though some note it takes practice.
Some reviewers say the colors don't match the photos, noting the black is actually brown or otherwise different.
A few reviewers report the magnet doesn't create the cat-eye effect or only works on some bottles.
Some reviewers mention durability issues, with the polish cracking or peeling within a week or two.
